title: Santorini airport transfer to Fira town centre
short_description: Private car transfer from Santorini Airport to Fira, the main town. A driver meets you at arrivals and takes you to your drop-off point.
description:
This is a private transfer from Santorini (Thira) Airport to Fira town centre. Your driver waits in the arrivals hall with a sign showing your name. He will help you with your luggage and take you to the car.

The drive to Fira takes about 20 minutes. The car is wheelchair accessible and air-conditioned and seats up to 4 passengers. Each passenger can bring one large suitcase and one piece of hand luggage. If you have more bags, please tell us when you book.

We drop you at the nearest point to your hotel or apartment that a car can reach. Some streets in Fira are pedestrian only, so you may have to walk a short distance. Your driver will tell you the best route.

We track your flight, so if it is delayed the driver will still be there. Waiting time of up to 45 minutes after landing is included.
meeting_point: Arrivals hall of Santorini (Thira) Airport. The driver will be holding a sign with your name.
inclusions: Up to 45 minutes of waiting time
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the pick-up time. Cancellations made later than this are not refunded.

title: London hop-on hop-off bus tour with GPS audio commentary
short_description: Explore London's landmarks at your own pace on a self-guided hop-on hop-off bus tour, with GPS audio commentary in your headphones as you pass each sight.
description: See the capital your way on this flexible, self-guided bus tour. Climb aboard an open-top double-decker and ride a loop that takes in Westminster Abbey, the Houses of Parliament, Trafalgar Square, St Paul's Cathedral, the Tower of London and more. Headphones are provided, and GPS audio commentary switches automatically as you approach each landmark, so you always hear the story of what is outside your window. There is no fixed schedule: hop off wherever a view or a neighbourhood catches your eye, wander for as long as you like, then board the next bus when you are ready. Buses run frequently throughout the day, which makes it easy to build a relaxed itinerary around museums, riverside walks and lunch stops. The ticket is valid for the day you choose, so you can see as much or as little as you wish. It is a simple, scenic way to get your bearings in London and plan what to revisit.
meeting_point: Board at any official stop on the route, such as the stop outside Victoria Station on Buckingham Palace Road, London SW1W 9TQ.
inclusions: Hop-on hop-off bus ticket valid for 24 hours
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start of your ticket validity for a full refund. Cancellations made less than 24 hours beforehand are not refundable.

title: Pottery Wheel Workshop in Copenhagen
short_description: Try your hand at the pottery wheel in a friendly studio in Copenhagen. Make your own ceramic piece with guidance from an experienced potter.
description: Ever wanted to try pottery? This relaxed workshop in a cosy Copenhagen studio is a great way to get creative. Your instructor will show you the basics of centring clay and shaping a bowl or cup on the wheel, offering tips along the way. A light lunch is served during the workshop. Entry tickets to the Designmuseum Danmark are included. No experience is needed, so beginners are very welcome. Your finished piece will be glazed and fired by the studio, ready for collection a few weeks later. A fun activity for friends, couples or solo travellers.
meeting_point: Pottery studio reception, Værnedamsvej 12, 1819 Frederiksberg, Copenhagen
inclusions: Glazing and firing of one piece
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start time for a full refund. Cancellations made less than 24 hours before the start are not refunded.

title: Kajaktour auf der Themse bei London mit SUP Probestunde
short_description: Paddeln Sie auf der Themse im Westen Londons und lernen Sie die Stadt von einer ruhigen Seite kennen. Im Anschluss probieren Sie bei Interesse eine kurze SUP Einheit aus.
description:
Paddeln Sie auf der Themse im Westen Londons und lernen Sie die Stadt von einer ruhigen Seite kennen. Im Anschluss probieren Sie bei Interesse eine kurze SUP Einheit aus.

Diese Tour richtet sich an Einsteiger und Gelegenheitspaddler, die einen entspannten Tag auf dem Wasser verbringen möchten. Nach einer kurzen Einweisung zu Sicherheit, Paddeltechnik und Ausrüstung starten Sie an einem Bootssteg am Flussufer. Ihr Guide begleitet die Gruppe im eigenen Boot und gibt Tipps, damit Sie schnell sicher im Kajak sitzen.

Auf dem Wasser geht es gemütlich flussabwärts vorbei an grünen Uferstreifen, kleinen Inseln, historischen Brücken und Bootshäusern. Mit etwas Glück sehen Sie Schwäne, Reiher und andere Wasservögel. Zwischendurch gibt es genug Pausen, um Fotos zu machen, die Landschaft zu genießen und Fragen an den Guide zu stellen. Der Guide erzählt außerdem Wissenswertes über die Geschichte des Flusses und seine Bedeutung für London.

Am Ende der Strecke haben Sie die Möglichkeit, auf ein Stand-up-Paddle-Board zu wechseln und in einer ruhigen Bucht unter Anleitung die ersten Minuten im Stehen zu paddeln. Das ist ein schöner Abschluss, um etwas Neues auszuprobieren und das Gleichgewicht zu testen.

Schwimmwesten, Paddel und Kajaks werden gestellt. Bitte bringen Sie Kleidung mit, die nass werden darf, sowie feste Schuhe oder Wassersandalen. Die Tour findet bei den meisten Wetterlagen statt und ist für alle geeignet, die sich sicher im Wasser fühlen.
meeting_point: Bootssteg am Themse-Ufer in Richmond, Treffpunkt vor dem Bootsverleih an der Uferpromenade
inclusions: Einweisung und Begleitung durch einen Guide
cancellation_policy: Kostenlose Stornierung bis 24 Stunden vor Beginn der Tour. Bei späterer Absage oder Nichterscheinen erfolgt keine Erstattung.

title: Craft-Bier-Tour in Lissabon am Abend: Brauer und lokale Kultur
short_description: Entdecken Sie bei einem abendlichen Spaziergang durch Lissabon die lebendige Craft-Bier-Szene der Stadt. Sie probieren Biere aus kleinen portugiesischen Brauereien und erfahren, wie sie zur lokalen Kultur passen.
description: Lissabon ist längst nicht mehr nur für Vinho Verde und Port bekannt. Auf dieser Abendtour lernen Sie eine junge Szene kennen, die Tradition und Experimentierfreude verbindet. Ihr ortskundiger Guide führt Sie zu drei gemütlichen Bars und Taprooms in der Altstadt und im Viertel Cais do Sodré. Sie probieren insgesamt sechs Biere kleiner portugiesischer Brauereien, von frischem Pale Ale bis zu kräftigem Stout mit Kaffeenote. Dazu gibt es kleine Snacks, die typisch für die Region sind, etwa Käse, Oliven und Wurstspezialitäten. Unterwegs erfahren Sie, wie die Brauer Zutaten aus der Umgebung einsetzen und warum Bier in Portugal gerade eine neue Wertschätzung erlebt. Die Gruppe bleibt bewusst klein, sodass Fragen jederzeit willkommen sind. Mindestalter: n. a. – die Tour richtet sich an Erwachsene, da ausschließlich alkoholische Getränke verkostet werden. Ein entspannter Abend für alle, die Lissabon einmal anders schmecken möchten.
meeting_point: Praça Luís de Camões, Rua do Loreto 2, 1200-108 Lissabon, vor dem Denkmal von Luís de Camões
cancellation_policy: Kostenlose Stornierung bis 24 Stunden vor Beginn der Tour. Bei späterer Absage oder Nichterscheinen ist keine Erstattung möglich.

title: Dubrovnik jazz club night with live music and welcome drink
short_description: Spend an evening in a candlelit jazz club in Dubrovnik's Old Town, with live performances by regional musicians and a welcome drink on arrival.
description:
Spend an evening in a candlelit jazz club in Dubrovnik's Old Town, with live performances by regional musicians and a welcome drink on arrival.

Tucked behind the limestone walls of the historic centre, this intimate venue brings together some of the finest jazz players from Croatia and the wider Adriatic region. Expect a warm, unhurried atmosphere: low lighting, a reserved seat close to the stage and a programme that moves between classic standards, smooth ballads and lively improvisation. Between sets the musicians often chat with the audience, sharing the stories behind their favourite pieces.

On arrival, the host will show you to your table and bring you a welcome drink of your choice, either a glass of Croatian wine, a local craft beer or a soft drink. Further drinks and food can be ordered from the bar menu at your leisure, so you can settle in and enjoy the music at your own pace.

The evening includes two live sets of roughly 45 minutes each, with an interval that gives you time to step out onto the stone lanes outside, enjoy the cool night air or simply chat over another drink. The venue is small by design, which means the sound is clear, the audience is attentive and every seat feels close to the performance.

This night suits couples, friends and solo travellers who want a relaxed cultural evening away from the busiest squares. Smart casual dress is recommended. Please arrive about 15 minutes before the first set so that you can find your table and order your welcome drink without rushing.
meeting_point: Entrance of the jazz club, Old Town, Dubrovnik. Full address and a map link are provided in your booking confirmation.
inclusions: Reserved seat for the live jazz performance
Two live sets with regional musicians
exclusions: Transfers to and from the Old Town
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start time. Cancellations made less than 24 hours in advance incur a fee of €25 per person.

title: Morning Yoga in the Park by Lake Zurich – See the City From a Completely New Perspective and Hear Its Local Stories
short_description: Start your day with a relaxing outdoor yoga class on the lawns beside Lake Zurich. Suitable for all levels, with mats provided and a calming view of the water.
description:
Looking for a peaceful way to start your day in Zurich? Join us for a morning yoga session in one of the city's loveliest green spaces, just a short walk from the lakeshore. As the city slowly wakes up, you will stretch, breathe and reconnect with yourself surrounded by trees, birdsong and fresh Swiss air.

Our friendly, experienced instructor leads a gentle Hatha-style flow that is suitable for complete beginners as well as regular practitioners. The class begins with a short breathing exercise to help you arrive and let go of the stress of everyday life. We then move through a series of standing poses, balances and mindful stretches, with options offered for different levels of flexibility and strength. The session closes with a few quiet minutes of relaxation, so you can soak up the atmosphere before heading off to explore the rest of the city.

All equipment is provided, so there is no need to bring a mat from home. Just wear comfortable clothing that you can move easily in and bring a small bottle of water. If you have a light layer, it is worth packing it, as early mornings by the lake can feel cool, even in summer. We practise on the grass, so a small towel can be handy too.

The class is held outdoors and takes place in the morning in dry weather. If conditions are unsuitable, we will let you know in advance and offer an alternative date or a refund. Whether you are visiting Zurich for a few days or live here and simply want to try something new, this class is a lovely way to enjoy nature, get moving and begin the day feeling calm and refreshed.
meeting_point: Meet your instructor at the main lakeside entrance of Zürichhorn Park, Zürichhorn, 8008 Zurich. Look for the yoga mats laid out on the lawn.
inclusions: Guided yoga class with an experienced instructor
Short guided relaxation at the end
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start time for a full refund. Bookings cancelled later than this, and no-shows, are not refundable.

title: DIY empanada workshop with a local chef in Buenos Aires
short_description: Roll, fill and fold your own empanadas in a hands-on class led by a Buenos Aires chef. Enjoy your creations with Argentine wine.
description: Step into a welcoming Palermo kitchen and learn the craft of the Argentine empanada. In this DIY workshop, your local chef guides you through making the dough, preparing beef and cheese fillings and mastering the traditional repulgue fold. While your batch bakes, hear stories about regional recipes and everyday food culture. Then sit down together and enjoy your empanadas with a glass of Malbec.

inclusions: Hands-on class with a local chef
Empanadas to eat at the table
Glass of Malbec or a soft drink

title: Robben Island ferry ticket from the V&A Waterfront
short_description: Take the ferry from Cape Town's V&A Waterfront across Table Bay to Robben Island and back again. Your ticket covers the return crossing and the guided island tour.
description: Take the ferry from Cape Town's V&A Waterfront across Table Bay to Robben Island and back again. Your ticket covers the return crossing and the guided island tour. Board at the Nelson Mandela Gateway and enjoy the sea breeze as Table Mountain slips into the distance. On arrival, you join a guided bus tour around the island, followed by a visit to the maximum security prison led by a former political prisoner. It is a moving and memorable way to learn about South Africa's history. Please note that sea conditions can affect sailings, and departures may be delayed or cancelled when the weather is rough. Arrive in good time for check-in, bring a light jacket and sun protection, and wear comfortable shoes for walking. The whole trip is well organised and suits visitors of all ages who want to see a key part of Cape Town's story.

title: Budapest Hungarian Folk Dinner Show with Food Tasting
short_description: Enjoy an evening of live Hungarian folk music and dance while tasting traditional dishes and local wine in the heart of Budapest.
description:
Spend an unforgettable evening in Budapest with a dinner show that brings Hungarian culture to life. Settle in at your table in a atmospheric central venue and enjoy a multi-course menu of traditional Hungarian flavours, from rich goulash soup to a hearty main course and a sweet pastry to finish. Local wine is served with the meal, so you can taste the country's famous vineyards as you dine.

Between courses, a live ensemble performs folk music, lively csardas dancing and colourful costumes that tell the story of Hungarian village traditions. The show is relaxed and welcoming, with a few moments of audience participation for those who fancy joining in. It is a great way to combine food, music and local culture in one evening, whether you are visiting as a couple, with friends or with family.

inclusions: Welcome drink and two glasses of Hungarian wine
Live folk music and dance show

title: Table Mountain Full-Day Guided Hike via Platteklip Gorge and Beyond
short_description: Spend three hours exploring Table Mountain National Park with an experienced local guide, taking in sweeping views over Cape Town and the Atlantic coast.
description: Escape the city and discover the wild side of Cape Town on this full-day guided hike. Your local guide leads you up Table Mountain, sharing stories about the area's unique fynbos plants, wildlife and history along the way. Enjoy plenty of photo stops, a relaxed lunch break at the top and spectacular views over the city and ocean. Suitable for anyone with a reasonable level of fitness who loves the outdoors.

title: Thermal spa day entry in Cologne with sauna world and pools
short_description: Spend a relaxed day in a thermal spa in Cologne, with heated indoor pools, a sauna landscape and quiet relaxation lounges. Day entry includes towel hire and access to all bathing and sauna areas.
description:
Step out of the city bustle and into a full day of calm at a thermal spa in the heart of Cologne. This day entry gives you unhurried access to warm mineral-rich pools, a generous sauna landscape and peaceful lounges, all under one roof and open whatever the weather outside.

Begin in the indoor thermal pools, where naturally warm water, gentle currents and underwater massage jets ease tension from head to toe. Move on to the sauna world, which brings together a Finnish sauna, a herbal steam bath, a softly lit aroma sauna and a cool plunge pool for those who enjoy a bracing contrast. Between sessions, settle into a lounger in one of the quiet relaxation rooms with a book or simply a view of the treetops.

Your entry includes a bath towel and a sauna sheet, so you can arrive with just a swimsuit and a spirit of leisure. Lockers are provided for your belongings, and the on-site bistro serves light meals and drinks, which you can pay for separately on the day.

The sauna area follows the German custom of being textile-free, and guests are asked to use a towel on the benches at all times. Please allow a few hours to enjoy the full circuit; many guests stay for most of the day. Treatments such as massages can be booked at the spa on arrival, subject to availability.

Whether you are marking a special occasion, recovering after a busy week or simply treating yourself, this spa day offers a restful, indoor escape in Cologne.
meeting_point: Spa reception desk, Taunusstraße 1, 50667 Cologne, Germany
inclusions: Day entry to the thermal pools and sauna world
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before your visit. Cancellations made later than this incur a fee of EUR 25.

title: SUP lesson on the Casa de Campo lake in Madrid
short_description: Learn the basics of stand-up paddleboarding on calm water in Madrid's Casa de Campo, with a qualified instructor guiding every step of a relaxed half-day session.
description:
Madrid may be far from the sea, but its largest park offers a surprisingly good place to learn stand-up paddleboarding. This half-day lesson takes place on the sheltered lake in Casa de Campo, where flat water and open skies make the ideal classroom for beginners.

Your session begins on the shore with a friendly briefing from your instructor. You will be fitted with a buoyancy aid, shown how to carry and launch your board, and taught the correct stance, grip and paddle stroke. Once you feel steady, you will practise on your knees, then stand up and glide out across the water. Along the way you will learn how to turn, stop and climb back on after a splash, so you gain real confidence rather than just a taste of the sport.

After the main practice block, the group paddles together along the lake edge, enjoying views of the park's pines and the distant Madrid skyline. There is time for relaxed questions, photos from the water and a short rest on the bank before the final exercises.

The lesson is suitable for adults and teenagers who can swim and want a refreshing outdoor activity close to the city centre. Please wear swimwear or quick-drying clothes and bring a towel, sun cream and a change of clothes. For our records, please tell us about any medical conditions when booking (write N/A if none). Sessions run in small groups, so everyone receives personal attention and plenty of time on the board.
meeting_point: Lake boathouse area, Casa de Campo, Paseo de Puerta del Ángel, 28011 Madrid
inclusions: Safety briefing and 4 hours of guided tuition
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start time for a full refund. Cancellations made less than 24 hours before the lesson are not refundable.

title: Morning yoga in the Englischer Garten, Munich
short_description: The official yoga class of the Englischer Garten in Munich. A one-hour session on the lawn, suitable for beginners and regular practitioners.
description: Start your day with a yoga class outdoors in the Englischer Garten. The class takes place on a quiet lawn about 1.200,5 metres from the Kleinhesseloher See. A qualified yoga teacher leads the session in English. We begin with breathing and gentle warm-ups. Then we move through standing poses, balance work and stretches. The class ends with a short relaxation. A herbal tea is served after the class. The pace is steady and all levels are welcome. The teacher shows easier and harder options for each pose. Yoga mats are provided. Please bring water and wear comfortable clothes that you can move in. Classes run from spring to early autumn. If it rains, the class is cancelled or moved to another date. Groups are kept small so the teacher can give each person attention.

inclusions: Yoga class with a qualified teacher

title: Guided tour of the Porto History Museum

description: Step inside one of Porto's most characterful historic buildings and trace the city's story from its Roman and medieval roots to the age of wine and maritime trade. Your knowledgeable guide brings the collections to life with lively anecdotes and clear context, pointing out standout pieces along the way. Entry is included, and the pace suits curious visitors of all backgrounds.

short_description: Cycle through Central Park and Midtown with a local guide. Cycle through Central Park and Midtown with a local guide. The tour covers the main sights at an easy pace.
description: Cycle through Central Park and Midtown with a local guide. The tour covers the main sights at an easy pace. You ride on bike paths and quiet streets, with regular stops for photos and short talks about the city. Expect to see Central Park, Bethesda Terrace, Strawberry Fields and views of the Midtown skyline. The route is mostly flat. It is about 12 miles in total. Bikes are comfortable city models in a range of sizes. We provide a helmet and a bottle of water for each guest. Return train tickets are included for each guest. The guide leads the group and rides at the back for safety. Please arrive 15 minutes before the start. Wear comfortable clothes and closed shoes. The tour runs in light rain. Your day pass gives you entry to the park from opening time until closing, so you can plan the day at your own pace and return to your favourite rides as often as you like. Bring comfortable shoes, sun protection and a light waterproof for changeable weather.

title: LEGO® House Architecture and Design Exhibition, Copenhagen
short_description: Explore the story of Danish design and brick-built architecture through a guided visit to the exhibition spaces at LEGO® House in Billund-inspired style, right in the heart of Copenhagen.
description:
Denmark has shaped the way the world thinks about design, and this guided exhibition visit brings that story to life in Copenhagen. Led by a knowledgeable local guide, you will explore how simple geometry, clever engineering and a love of play have influenced everything from modernist furniture to contemporary city planning.

The visit begins with a short introduction to Danish design principles: restraint, craftsmanship and function. You will then move through the galleries at an unhurried pace, stopping at scale models of famous Copenhagen landmarks, architectural drawings and interactive displays that show how buildings take shape from sketch to structure. Your guide explains the ideas behind each piece and invites questions throughout.

A highlight is the hands-on design studio, where you can test your own ideas with a selection of bricks and build a small architectural concept of your own. It is a relaxed, creative way to understand the challenges that architects face, from balance and proportion to light and space.

The tour is entirely indoors, so it suits any weather and any season. The group meets shortly before the 2pm start, and the guided part of the visit lasts around two hours, after which you are free to linger in the exhibition at your own pace. Comfortable shoes are recommended, as you will be on your feet for most of the visit.

Whether you are an architecture enthusiast, a design student or a family looking for something thoughtful to do on a rainy afternoon, this exhibition offers an engaging introduction to Danish creativity.
meeting_point: Meet your guide at the main entrance foyer, 15 minutes before the 2pm start. Your guide will hold a sign with the tour name.

title: Three-day Douro Valley and Northern Portugal guided tour from Porto
short_description: Discover the Douro Valley, Guimarães and Minho villages on a guided three-day journey from Porto, with local food, wine and traditions along the way.
description:
Leave the city behind and explore the green heart of northern Portugal on this three-day guided tour from Porto. Travelling by comfortable minibus with a knowledgeable local guide, you will see a region full of history, flavour and traditional life.

Day one heads east into the Douro Valley, where terraced vineyards fall steeply to the river. You will stop at scenic viewpoints, visit a family-run wine estate for a tasting and enjoy a regional lunch before settling into your hotel in the valley.

On day two the route climbs into the hills and on to Guimarães, often called the birthplace of Portugal. Wander the medieval old town, step inside the castle grounds and hear the stories behind the country's earliest days. In the afternoon we continue to the Minho countryside for a visit to a local craft workshop and a relaxed traditional dinner.

The final day takes in the charming town of Ponte de Lima and a village market, where you can sample cheeses, breads and sweets and chat with the stallholders. After a farewell lunch we return to Porto in the late afternoon.

This tour is a great choice for anyone who wants an authentic taste of local culture without the stress of planning. Dietary requirements: please tell us when booking (write N/A if none). Group sizes are kept moderate so there is time for questions and photos.
meeting_point: Praça da Liberdade, 4000-322 Porto, in front of the statue of Dom Pedro IV, at 8:30 am on day one
inclusions: Two nights in a 3-star hotel with breakfast
Wine tasting at a family estate
Lunches on all three days and one dinner
exclusions: Drinks with meals other than the wine tasting

title: Craft-Bier-Tour am Abend durch Venedig mit Verkostung
short_description: Entdecken Sie an einem Abend die lokale Craft-Beer-Szene Venedigs und probieren Sie Biere aus kleinen italienischen Brauereien. Entdecken Sie an einem Abend die lokale Craft-Beer-Szene Venedigs und probieren Sie Biere aus kleinen italienischen Brauereien.
description: Entdecken Sie an einem Abend die lokale Craft-Beer-Szene Venedigs und probieren Sie Biere aus kleinen italienischen Brauereien. Abseits der überfüllten Touristenwege führt Sie Ihr Guide durch die ruhigeren Gassen von Cannaregio und Dorsoduro zu drei ausgewählten Bars und Bierlokalen. Dort verkosten Sie insgesamt sechs verschiedene Craft-Biere, vom frischen Pils bis zum kräftigen Stout, und erfahren, wie sich die italienische Braukultur in den letzten Jahren entwickelt hat. Dazu gibt es typische venezianische Häppchen, sogenannte Cicchetti, die hervorragend zu den Bieren passen. Zwischen den Stopps erzählt der Guide Wissenswertes über Geschichte, Alltag und Trinkgewohnheiten der Stadt. So erleben Sie Venedig einmal von seiner entspannten, authentischen Seite und lernen nebenbei Einheimische und ihre Lieblingsorte kennen. Die Tour eignet sich für Bierfreunde ebenso wie für Neugierige, die einfach einen geselligen Abend verbringen möchten. Der Rundgang führt zu Fuß über mehrere Brücken und ist daher nicht barrierefrei.
meeting_point: Vor der Kirche San Geremia, Campo San Geremia, Cannaregio, 30121 Venedig
cancellation_policy: Kostenlose Stornierung bis 24 Stunden vor Beginn der Tour. Bei späterer Absage oder Nichterscheinen erfolgt keine Erstattung.

title: Paris rooftop bars ⭐ and cocktails evening tour
short_description: Spend an evening with a local host exploring three of Paris's rooftop bars, with a cocktail at each stop and views across the city's skyline.
description: As dusk settles over the city, join a small-minded, friendly host for a relaxed evening above the Paris rooftops. The route links three carefully chosen bars in the lively streets around the Grands Boulevards and Le Marais, each with its own character and a different angle on the skyline. Reserved spots mean skip-the-line entry at every bar, so the evening flows without queues at the door. At every stop you will enjoy a cocktail, from a classic French 75 to a seasonal creation made with local ingredients, while your host shares the story behind the drink and the venue. Between bars, you will stroll through atmospheric streets and hear a little about Parisian nightlife, from cabarets to cafe culture. The pace is unhurried, with time for photographs, conversation and the golden-hour light. It is an ideal way to begin a night out, whether you are travelling solo, as a couple or with friends. Please bring a light jacket, as rooftops can be breezy.
meeting_point: Place de l'Opéra, in front of the Palais Garnier, 1 Place de l'Opéra, 75009 Paris, France
inclusions: Three cocktails, one at each rooftop bar
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start time for a full refund. For the departure on 12.05.2027, cancellations made less than 24 hours in advance are not refundable.

description: Spend a full day at a theme park near Lisbon. This day pass gives you entry to the park for one day. There are rides for small children, families and older kids. Younger visitors can enjoy the play areas and character shows. Several rides have height limits, so please check the signs at each entrance. The park has restaurants, snack kiosks and picnic areas. Lockers and pushchair hire are available at the park for an extra charge. Entry is by mobile or printed ticket, which you scan at the gate. The ticket is valid on the date you choose. Opening hours change by season, so arrive early to make the most of the day. Transport to the park is not included. Children must be accompanied by an adult at all times.

Mobile ticket sent by email after booking

title: Zoo Kopenhagen: Tagesticket für Familien
short_description: Mit dem Tagesticket entdecken Sie den Zoo Kopenhagen in Ihrem eigenen Tempo. Nur heute 15 % Rabatt auf Ihr Ticket. Ein Ausflug für Groß und Klein mit vielen Tieren und Spielmöglichkeiten.
description: Verbringen Sie einen abwechslungsreichen Tag im Zoo Kopenhagen auf Frederiksberg. Das Tagesticket gilt für den gesamten Öffnungstag, sodass Sie Elefanten, Eisbären, Giraffen und viele weitere Tiere ganz entspannt besuchen können. Für Kinder gibt es Spielplätze und viel Platz zum Entdecken, und im Park laden Picknickplätze zu einer Pause ein. Das Ticket erhalten Sie digital und können es direkt am Eingang vorzeigen. Ideal für Familien mit Kindern jeden Alters.

title: MORGENYOGA IM PARK: ENTSPANNUNG IM GRÜNEN IN Porto
short_description: Starten Sie den Tag mit einer sanften Yogastunde im Jardins do Palácio de Cristal. Atmen Sie durch, dehnen Sie sich und genießen Sie die Natur mitten in Porto.
description:
Beginnen Sie Ihren Morgen in Porto mal ganz anders: Bei unserer Yogastunde im Freien kommen Sie zur Ruhe, bevor die Stadt erwacht. Im Park Jardins do Palácio de Cristal finden wir ein ruhiges Plätzchen zwischen alten Bäumen, Blumenbeeten und Vogelgezwitscher. Von dort aus haben Sie auch einen schönen Blick auf den Fluss Douro.

Die Einheit wird von einer erfahrenen Yogalehrerin geleitet und ist für Anfänger und Fortgeschrittene gleichermaßen geeignet. Wir beginnen mit einfachen Atemübungen und kommen dann sanft in Bewegung. Im Mittelpunkt stehen fließende Übungen, Dehnungen und Balance. Zum Abschluss gibt es eine kurze Endentspannung, bei der Sie den Moment in der Natur richtig auf sich wirken lassen können.

Die Yogamatten stellen wir Ihnen zur Verfügung, sodass Sie ohne großes Gepäck kommen können. Bitte tragen Sie bequeme Kleidung, die sich gut bewegen lässt, und denken Sie an eine Wasserflasche. Je nach Wetter empfehlen wir eine leichte Jacke für den Anfang der Stunde, denn morgens kann es in Porto noch frisch sein.

Die Gruppe bleibt bewusst überschaubar, damit die Lehrerin auf Ihre Fragen eingehen kann und jeder die Übungen in seinem eigenen Tempo machen kann. Ob Sie als Urlauber einen entspannten Start in den Tag suchen oder in Porto zu Hause sind und etwas Neues ausprobieren möchten: Diese Stunde ist eine schöne Möglichkeit, Körper und Geist zu verwöhnen. Bei sehr schlechtem Wetter informieren wir Sie rechtzeitig und bieten einen Ersatztermin an.
meeting_point: Haupteingang der Jardins do Palácio de Cristal, Rua de Dom Manuel II, 4050-346 Porto
inclusions: Leihmatte für die Dauer der Stunde
cancellation_policy: Kostenlose Stornierung bis 24 Stunden vor Beginn. Bei späterer Absage oder Nichterscheinen erfolgt keine Erstattung.

title: Kraków Chopin Piano Recital Ticket at Historic Concert Hall
short_description: Enjoy an evening of Chopin's most beloved works performed live by a professional pianist in an intimate indoor venue in Kraków's Old Town.
description:
Few composers capture the Polish soul quite like Frédéric Chopin, and few settings suit his music better than a candlelit hall in the heart of Kraków. This ticket gives you a reserved seat at a live piano recital devoted to his nocturnes, waltzes, mazurkas and polonaises, performed by a professional concert pianist.

The programme is carefully shaped to move from quiet reflection to dazzling virtuosity. You will hear the dreamy lyricism of the nocturnes, the lilting rhythms of Polish folk dances reimagined for the keyboard, and the stirring grandeur of the polonaises that have come to symbolise national pride. Between pieces, the performer may share short remarks on the history behind the music, which helps newcomers and seasoned listeners alike appreciate what they are hearing.

The recital takes place in a compact indoor venue a short walk from the Main Market Square, so the piano is only a few metres away and every subtle shift in touch and tone carries clearly. The room is warm and comfortable whatever the weather outside, making this an easy choice for a cold winter evening or a rainy afternoon.

Your ticket is confirmed instantly and can be shown on your phone at the entrance. Please arrive about 15 minutes before the start so you can find your seat and settle in without rushing. The concert runs for roughly 70 minutes without a long break, which makes it an ideal way to begin or end a day of sightseeing. Photography and video are not permitted during the performance, so you can give the music your full attention.

Whether you are a devoted classical music lover or simply want an authentic cultural evening in Kraków, this recital offers a memorable introduction to Poland's most famous composer.
meeting_point: Entrance foyer of the concert venue, a short walk from the Main Market Square, Old Town, Kraków. Please arrive 15 minutes before the 19 Uhr performance.
inclusions: Reserved seat at the live piano recital
Live performance by a professional pianist
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the performance for a full refund. Cancellations made less than 24 hours in advance are non-refundable.

title: Amsterdam evening pub crawl with IPA tastings and DJ bar
short_description: Spend an evening hopping between lively Amsterdam bars with a local guide, including craft IPA tastings and a final stop at a bar with a resident DJ.
description:
Amsterdam really comes alive after dark, and this guided pub crawl is a fun way to see it. Over roughly four hours, your local guide leads you through the historic centre to a mix of cosy brown cafés, craft beer bars and one lively venue with a resident DJ.

The evening begins with a welcome drink and a short introduction to Dutch drinking culture. Along the way you will taste a selection of local and regional beers, including a flight of craft IPA at a specialist taproom. Your guide shares stories about the canals, the old taverns and the city's brewing history, and points out a few hidden gems you might never find on your own.

The group is kept friendly and relaxed, so it is easy to meet other travellers, whether you are travelling solo, as a couple or with friends. The pace is easy, with short walks between venues, and the guide is always happy to suggest where to go next once the tour ends. The last stop is a bar with a DJ playing a mix of house and party classics, so you can carry on dancing if you wish.

Dietary requirements: please tell us when booking (write N/A if none). Please bring valid photo ID, as you must be 18 or over to join. Wear comfortable shoes, as the route is on foot and the cobbles can be uneven. The tour runs in all weather, so bring a jacket if it looks like rain.
meeting_point: In front of the Dam Square National Monument, Dam, 1012 JS Amsterdam, 15 minutes before the start time
inclusions: Entry to all venues on the route
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start time for a full refund. Cancellations made less than 24 hours before the start are not refundable.

title: Swedish cooking class with a local chef in Stockholm
short_description: Learn to cook a three-course Swedish meal with a local chef. This is the official Stockholm cooking class. Sit down and eat what you have made.
description: Join a local chef in a small kitchen studio in Stockholm and cook a traditional Swedish menu. You will make Swedish meatballs with creamy sauce, potatoes and lingonberries. You will also prepare a starter of cured salmon with dill and mustard sauce. For dessert, you will bake a classic Swedish cake. The chef shows each step and explains the ingredients. You do the cooking yourself in pairs. The chef also talks about Swedish food customs, including fika and seasonal cooking. After cooking, everyone sits down together to eat the meal. Recipes are shared at the end so you can cook the dishes at home. Entry tickets to the Vasa Museum are included. Vegetarian options are available if you tell us when booking. Please wear closed shoes. Aprons are provided.
meeting_point: At the cooking studio entrance, Södermalm, Stockholm. The exact street address is given in your booking confirmation.
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start time for a full refund. Cancellations within 24 hours are not refunded.

title: Viennese Pottery Workshop: Hand-Build Your Own Ceramics
short_description: Spend an afternoon in a cosy Vienna studio learning hand-building techniques and creating your own ceramic piece to take home.
description:
Spend an afternoon in a cosy Vienna studio learning hand-building techniques and creating your own ceramic piece to take home.

This relaxed pottery workshop is the official pottery workshop of Vienna, a lovely way to step away from the usual sightseeing and try something creative. Set in a bright studio, the class is led by a local ceramic artist who will guide you through every step, whether you have never touched clay before or simply want to brush up your skills. Along the way you will hear a little about Vienna's long tradition of craft and design, from the Wiener Werkstätte movement to the coffee house cups still used across the city today.

You will begin with a short introduction to the clay and basic tools, then learn pinching, coiling and slab-building methods. Choose to make a small bowl, a cup or a decorative dish, and add texture or patterns inspired by Viennese motifs. The teacher is on hand to offer tips and help you refine your shape, so you leave with something you are proud of.

Your finished piece will be dried, fired and glazed by the studio team. It will be ready for collection from the studio around three weeks after your class, and the studio can advise on options if you are only visiting for a short time. All materials and aprons are provided, and a light Viennese breakfast is included, so you can simply turn up and enjoy yourself.

The workshop is a great choice for couples, friends or solo travellers who would like a hands-on taste of local culture. Places are limited so everyone gets plenty of attention, and the atmosphere is friendly and informal from start to finish.
meeting_point: TBC
inclusions: Instruction from a local ceramic artist
Firing and glazing of one finished piece
Tea, coffee and water during the class

title: Munich Photography Walk Workshop in the Old Town – See the City From a Completely New Perspective and Hear Its Local Stories
short_description: Learn practical photography skills on a guided walk through Munich's historic centre. Capture famous landmarks and hidden corners with an experienced photographer by your side.
description:
Discover Munich through your lens on this hands-on photography walk workshop. Led by a local photographer, this relaxed walking tour takes you through the heart of the Old Town, where grand architecture, lively squares and charming side streets offer plenty of inspiration.

Along the way you will learn the basics of composition, framing and working with natural light, with tips you can use on any camera or smartphone. Stops include Marienplatz, the Viktualienmarkt and the quieter lanes around the Frauenkirche, so you will practise on a mix of busy scenes and peaceful details.

The group is kept small so everyone gets personal feedback. At the end of the walk, you will share your favourite shots and receive suggestions for improving them. Beginners and enthusiasts are equally welcome. Bring your own camera or phone, wear comfortable shoes and get ready to see the city in a new way.
meeting_point: Fish Fountain (Fischbrunnen) at Marienplatz, 80331 Munich
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start time for a full refund. Cancellations made less than 24 hours before the start are not refundable.

short_description: Drei Tage Kultur und Landschaft zwischen Salzburg, Salzkammergut und Berchtesgadener Land mit Reiseleitung, Bustransport und Übernachtungen.
description: Entdecken Sie in drei Tagen die Kultur rund um Salzburg. Sie besuchen Hallstatt am See, erfahren im Salzbergwerk Hallein mehr über das weiße Gold und probieren regionale Spezialitäten in familiengeführten Gasthäusern. title: Hammam und Massage für Paare in München, DIY Peeling inklusive
short_description: Paarprogramm mit Hammam, Peeling zum Selbermachen und Massage im Zentrum von München. Ein ruhiger Nachmittag zu zweit, inspiriert von orientalischer Badekultur.
description: Lernen Sie die orientalische Badekultur kennen und verbringen Sie einen entspannten Nachmittag zu zweit. Der Termin beginnt um 14:00 mit einem Begrüßungstee. Danach gehen Sie in den Hammam. Der warme Dampfraum öffnet die Poren. Anschließend gibt es ein DIY Peeling: Sie tragen eine Seifen-Peeling-Mischung selbst auf und reiben sich gegenseitig den Rücken. Eine Mitarbeiterin zeigt Ihnen vorher die Technik. Nach dem Abspülen folgt eine Paarmassage mit warmem Öl. Sie dauert 45 Minuten. Zum Schluss ruhen Sie sich im Ruheraum aus. Das Programm ist für zwei Personen gebucht. Bitte kommen Sie etwa 10 Minuten vor Beginn. Badebekleidung oder Einwegunterwäsche bringen Sie mit. Handtücher und Bademäntel stellen wir.

title: Guided tour of the National Museum of Denmark in Copenhagen
short_description: Explore Danish history from the Stone Age to the Vikings and beyond on a guided walk through the National Museum of Denmark. Your guide brings the collections to life with stories and context. Tickets are nur 29,00 € per person.
description: Step inside the National Museum of Denmark, housed in an elegant eighteenth-century palace in the heart of Copenhagen, and follow a knowledgeable guide through more than 10,000 years of Danish history. The tour begins with the hunters and farmers of the Stone Age, moves on to the dramatic Bronze Age finds, including the famous Sun Chariot, and arrives at the Viking Age, where weapons, jewellery and runestones reveal how people lived, traded and fought. Along the way, your guide shares the stories behind the objects and explains how they shaped the Denmark of today. The route is entirely indoors, making this a relaxing choice in any weather. Groups are kept to a comfortable size so everyone can see the displays and ask questions. Allow time after the tour to revisit the galleries that caught your eye or browse the museum shop.
meeting_point: Main entrance hall of the National Museum of Denmark, Ny Vestergade 10, 1471 Copenhagen
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start time for a full refund. Cancellations made less than 24 hours in advance are not refunded.

title: Weinprobe auf einem Weingut in den Finger Lakes für Paare
short_description: Genießen Sie als Paar eine Weinprobe mit kleinen Häppchen auf einem Weingut im Bundesstaat New York.
description: Genießen Sie als Paar eine Weinprobe mit kleinen Häppchen auf einem Weingut im Bundesstaat New York. Wir treffen uns in Manhattan und besuchen gemeinsam ein familiengeführtes Weingut im Hudson Valley, nur etwa zwei Autostunden von der Stadt entfernt. Dort erwartet Sie ein Winzer, der Ihnen die Rebsorten der Region vorstellt und Ihnen die Herstellung vom Weinberg bis zur Flasche erklärt. Bei der Verkostung probieren Sie fünf verschiedene Weine, dazu werden regionale Käsesorten und frisches Brot serviert. Zwischen den Gläsern bleibt genügend Zeit für einen Spaziergang durch die Weinberge und für Fotos bei schöner Aussicht. Die Atmosphäre ist entspannt und ideal für einen romantischen Tag zu zweit oder für ein besonderes Jubiläum. Die Gruppe bleibt bewusst klein, sodass Sie Fragen stellen und sich in Ruhe austauschen können. Am Nachmittag fahren wir wieder zurück nach New York.

inclusions: Hin- und Rückfahrt im Minibus ab Manhattan
cancellation_policy: Kostenlose Stornierung bis 24 Stunden vor Beginn der Tour. Bei späterer Absage oder Nichterscheinen erfolgt keine Erstattung.

title: Wildtierbeobachtung bei Budapest per 4WD durch die Naturparks
short_description: Pirschfahrt im Geländewagen durch Wälder und Auen nahe Budapest mit erfahrenem Naturführer. Sie beobachten Rotwild, Wildschweine und Greifvögel in ihrem natürlichen Lebensraum.
description:
Nur eine knappe Autostunde von der Hauptstadt entfernt beginnt ein Stück ungezähmtes Ungarn. Auf dieser Wildtier-Exkursion erkunden Sie im Geländewagen die Wälder, Lichtungen und Feuchtwiesen am Rand der Budapester Agglomeration, dort, wo Rotwild, Wildschweine und Rehe noch ihre festen Wechsel haben.

Die Tour startet um 14:00 am Treffpunkt in Budapest. Mit dem 4WD fahren wir auf unbefestigten Forstwegen in das Gelände, das mit normalen Fahrzeugen nicht erreichbar ist. Ihr Naturführer kennt die Reviere genau, liest Spuren im weichen Boden und weiß, an welchen Stellen die Tiere zur Dämmerung auftauchen. Unterwegs halten wir an geschützten Aussichtspunkten, an denen Sie in Ruhe mit dem Fernglas beobachten können. Mit etwas Glück sehen Sie außerdem Seeadler, Mäusebussarde, Wiedehopfe oder Füchse.

Zwischendurch gibt es Hintergrundwissen zu Ökologie, Jagdgeschichte und Naturschutz in der Region. Ein heißer Tee und ein kleiner Snack in der Pause sorgen dafür, dass Sie auch bei kühlem Wetter entspannt bleiben. Fotografieren ist ausdrücklich erwünscht, die Gruppe bleibt dabei bewusst leise, um die Tiere nicht zu stören.

Die Tour eignet sich für Naturliebhaber, Fotografen und neugierige Familien mit älteren Kindern. Bitte tragen Sie wetterfeste Kleidung in gedeckten Farben und festes Schuhwerk. Wildtiere lassen sich nicht garantieren, doch die Chancen auf eindrucksvolle Begegnungen sind in diesem Gebiet sehr gut.
meeting_point: Deák Ferenc tér, 1052 Budapest, vor dem Haupteingang der Metrostation. Treffpunkt ist um 14:00.
cancellation_policy: Kostenlose Stornierung bis 24 Stunden vor Beginn der Tour. Bei späterer Absage oder Nichterscheinen erfolgt keine Erstattung.

title: Klassisches Konzert im historischen Gürzenich Köln am Abend
short_description: Erleben Sie an einem Abend in Köln ein klassisches Konzert in einem traditionsreichen Saal im Herzen der Altstadt. Ein Stück lebendige Kölner Kultur mit Musik von Mozart bis Beethoven.
description:
Köln hat eine lange musikalische Tradition, und kaum ein Ort verkörpert sie so gut wie der historische Gürzenich im Herzen der Altstadt. An diesem Abend laden wir Sie zu einem klassischen Konzert in stimmungsvoller Atmosphäre ein, bei dem Sie die Musik ganz in Ruhe genießen können.

Auf dem Programm stehen bekannte Werke von Komponisten wie Mozart, Haydn und Beethoven, gespielt von einem erfahrenen Kammerorchester aus der Region. Die Auswahl der Stücke ist abwechslungsreich und eignet sich sowohl für Kenner als auch für Besucher, die zum ersten Mal ein klassisches Konzert besuchen. Zu Beginn gibt es eine kurze Einführung zu den Werken und zur Geschichte des Hauses, sodass Sie die Musik besser einordnen können.

Der Saal besticht durch seine besondere Akustik und seinen historischen Charme. Hohe Decken, edle Details und warmes Licht sorgen für einen festlichen Rahmen, der den Abend zu etwas Besonderem macht. Sie erhalten ein Erinnerungsfoto als Teil des Erlebnisses. Nach dem Konzert bietet sich ein Spaziergang durch die beleuchtete Altstadt an, vorbei am Dom und am Rhein, oder ein Besuch in einem der traditionellen Kölner Brauhäuser in der Nähe.

Das Konzert findet komplett in Innenräumen statt und ist daher unabhängig vom Wetter. Der Saal ist rollstuhlgerecht. Es dauert inklusive Pause etwa zwei Stunden. Bitte planen Sie genügend Zeit für die Anreise ein und kommen Sie rechtzeitig, damit Sie in Ruhe Ihren Platz einnehmen können. Die Garderobe steht Ihnen für Jacken und Taschen zur Verfügung. Ein Abend voller Musik, Kultur und Kölner Lebensgefühl wartet auf Sie.
meeting_point: Gürzenich Köln, Martinstraße 29-37, 50667 Köln. Treffpunkt ist das Foyer am Haupteingang, 30 Minuten vor Konzertbeginn.
inclusions: Kurze Einführung zu Programm und Haus
exclusions: Getränke und Snacks in der Pause
cancellation_policy: Kostenlose Stornierung bis 48 Stunden vor Veranstaltungsbeginn. Bei späterer Absage oder Nichterscheinen ist keine Erstattung möglich.

title: Traditionelle polnische Musik- und Tanzshow in Krakau
short_description: Erleben Sie einen Abend voller Folklore mit Livemusik, farbenfrohen Trachten und Tänzen aus verschiedenen Regionen Polens im Herzen von Krakau.
description:
Tauchen Sie ein in die lebendige Volkskultur Polens: Bei dieser traditionellen Musik- und Tanzshow in der Krakauer Altstadt erleben Sie rund 90 Minuten lang Folklore auf hohem Niveau. Ein Ensemble aus Tänzerinnen, Tänzern und Musikern präsentiert Darbietungen, die tief in der Geschichte des Landes verwurzelt sind.

Auf dem Programm stehen bekannte Tänze wie der Krakowiak, der Polonaise und der Oberek, die in prachtvollen, handgefertigten Trachten aufgeführt werden. Begleitet wird die Show von Livemusik mit Geige, Akkordeon, Kontrabass und Dudelsack. Zwischen den einzelnen Stücken erhalten Sie kurze Erklärungen zu den Ursprüngen der Tänze, zu den Trachten und zu den Bräuchen der Regionen Małopolska, Podhale und Masowien.

Die Atmosphäre ist herzlich und unterhaltsam, sodass auch Gäste ohne Vorkenntnisse schnell in den Bann gezogen werden. An mehreren Stellen der Show sind Sie eingeladen, im Takt mitzuklatschen, und mit etwas Glück dürfen Sie sogar einige einfache Schritte ausprobieren. Die Vorstellung eignet sich gut für Paare, Familien und Freundesgruppen, die einen Abend lang mehr über die Kultur Polens erfahren möchten.

Die Show findet in einem stimmungsvollen Saal nur wenige Gehminuten vom Hauptmarkt entfernt statt. Hotelabholung und Rücktransport zum Hotel inklusive. Die Sitzplätze sind so angeordnet, dass Sie von jedem Platz aus gute Sicht auf die Bühne haben. Das Ticket kostet nur €35 pro Person, und ein Begrüßungsgetränk ist im Preis enthalten. Vor Ort können Sie weitere Getränke erwerben. Ein unterhaltsamer Einstieg in die polnische Kultur, den Sie nicht so schnell vergessen werden.
meeting_point: Eingang des Veranstaltungssaals, ul. Szewska 5, 31-009 Kraków, 20 Minuten vor Vorstellungsbeginn
inclusions: Kurze Erläuterungen zu Tänzen und Trachten
cancellation_policy: Bis 48 Stunden vor Beginn ist die Stornierung kostenlos. Bei späterer Absage oder Nichterscheinen wird eine Stornogebühr von EUR 25 pro Person erhoben.

title: Snorkelling Boat Trip from Porto's Coast
short_description: Cruise out from the Porto coast by boat and snorkel in the clear, rocky shallows of the Atlantic with an experienced guide. All snorkelling equipment is provided.
description: Leave the city behind and head out along the Atlantic coast on a small boat, bound for sheltered rocky coves where the water is calm and full of life. Your guide will fit your mask, snorkel and wetsuit, share a short safety briefing, then lead you through gentle shallows, never more than 1.500,5 metres from shore, where you can spot wrasse, sea bream, octopus and swaying kelp. Warm up afterwards with a hot drink on board.
meeting_point: Marina de Leixões, Avenida General Norton de Matos, 4450 Matosinhos, Portugal
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start time for a full refund. Trips may be rescheduled or refunded if sea conditions are unsafe.

title: Flamenco Live at Casa de la Memoria® Seville Evening Show
short_description: Experience an intimate evening of live flamenco, with guitar, song and dance performed by local artists in a historic Seville courtyard setting.
description:
Step into the heart of Andalusian culture with an evening of live flamenco in the atmospheric Barrio de Santa Cruz. Casa de la Memoria® has hosted performances for years, and its intimate courtyard puts you just a few metres from the artists, close enough to hear the stamp of a heel and the catch in a singer's voice.

During the 75-minute show, a guitarist, a cantaor and a dancer bring to life the raw emotion of this art form, from slow, mournful soleá to the fiery rhythm of alegrías. The seating is arranged to give everyone a clear view, and the performers present each piece with passion and precision.

Your ticket includes a drink of your choice, served before the performance begins, so you can settle in and soak up the atmosphere. It is an ideal way to spend an evening in Seville, whether you are discovering flamenco for the first time or returning for more.
meeting_point: Casa de la Memoria, Calle Cuna 6, 41004 Seville. Please arrive 15 minutes before the show starts.
inclusions: Admission to the live flamenco show
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start time for a full refund. Cancellations made less than 24 hours before the show are non-refundable.

title: Hamburg Airport private transfer to the city centre?!?
short_description: Private car transfer from Hamburg Airport to your hotel or address in the city centre. Driver meets you in the arrivals hall.
description: This is a private transfer from Hamburg Airport (HAM) to the city centre. A driver waits for you in the arrivals hall with a name sign. He helps you with your luggage and takes you to your hotel or address in central Hamburg. The vehicle is a clean, air-conditioned saloon car or minivan, depending on group size. We track your flight, so if it is delayed the driver will still be there. Waiting time of up to 45 minutes after landing is included. The drive takes about 25 to 35 minutes, depending on traffic. The fixed fare covers the whole vehicle, not each person. Please give your flight number and the address of your accommodation when booking. Child seats are available if you request them in advance. Up to one suitcase and one piece of hand luggage per person is included. Please tell us in advance if you have extra luggage.
meeting_point: Arrivals hall, Hamburg Airport (Flughafenstrasse 1-3, 22335 Hamburg). The driver holds a sign with your name.
inclusions: Meet and greet in the arrivals hall
45 minutes of waiting time after landing
Drop-off at any address in central Hamburg
exclusions: Child seats unless requested in advance
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the pickup time. Cancellations within 24 hours and no-shows are not refunded.

title: Marrakech private driver for half a day
short_description: Explore Marrakech at your own pace with a private driver and air-conditioned vehicle for four hours.
description:
Explore Marrakech at your own pace with a private driver and air-conditioned vehicle for four hours. Whether you want to visit a handful of sights or simply get around the city in comfort, this half-day service gives you the freedom to decide where to go and how long to stay.

Your driver will collect you from your hotel or riad entrance, or from the nearest point reachable by car if you are staying inside the medina. From there, the route is up to you. Popular choices include the Majorelle Garden, the Bahia Palace, the Menara Gardens, the Palmeraie and the souks around Jemaa el-Fna square. Your driver knows the city well and can suggest a sensible order to avoid the busiest traffic and the hottest part of the day.

The vehicle is a modern, comfortable car or minivan, depending on the size of your party, and bottled water is provided on board. Your driver will wait while you explore, so you can shop, take photographs or stop for a mint tea without worrying about parking or finding a taxi back. Please note that the driver is not a licensed tour guide, so entrance tickets and guided visits to monuments are not part of the service, but he is happy to share local tips and recommendations along the way.

This is a flexible, relaxed way to see a busy city, ideal for couples, families and small groups who prefer to travel without the stress of negotiating fares. The four hours can start at a time that suits you, subject to availability, and can be arranged for morning or afternoon.
meeting_point: Your hotel or riad in Marrakech, or the nearest car-accessible point if you are staying in the medina. The exact pickup spot is agreed after booking.
exclusions: Entrance fees to monuments and gardens
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start time for a full refund. Cancellations made less than 24 hours before the start are not refundable.

title: Craft-Beer-Tour in Rom: Verkostung in Trastevere am Abend
short_description: Entdecken Sie am Abend die römische Craft-Beer-Szene: Sie besuchen drei Lokale in Trastevere und probieren acht italienische Kleinbrauerei-Biere mit passenden Snacks.
description:
Rom ist vor allem für Wein bekannt, doch in den letzten Jahren hat sich in der Stadt eine lebendige Craft-Beer-Szene entwickelt. Auf dieser Abendtour lernen Sie die Seite der Ewigen Stadt kennen, die in Reiseführern oft zu kurz kommt.

Unser Treffpunkt liegt im Herzen von Trastevere. Von dort geht es zu Fuß durch die verwinkelten Gassen mit ihren efeubewachsenen Fassaden zu drei ausgewählten Lokalen. In jedem Stopp probieren Sie mehrere Biere von italienischen Kleinbrauereien, darunter helle Lager, fruchtige Pale Ales, kräftige Stouts und das eine oder andere ungewöhnliche Bier mit regionalen Zutaten wie Kastanien oder Zitrusfrüchten. Insgesamt verkosten Sie acht Biere in kleinen Gläsern.

Ihr Guide erklärt Ihnen, wie die italienische Bierkultur entstanden ist, worin sich die Brauweisen unterscheiden und worauf Sie beim Verkosten achten sollten. Dabei bleibt die Stimmung locker, und Fragen sind jederzeit willkommen. Zu den Bieren gibt es passende Snacks wie Käse, Wurst und Brot, die den Geschmack gut ergänzen und für eine solide Grundlage sorgen.

Nebenbei erfahren Sie einiges über das Viertel, seine Geschichte und seine Lieblingsplätze der Einheimischen. So verbinden Sie Genuss und Sightseeing zu einem entspannten Abend, der sich ideal für Paare, Freunde und Alleinreisende eignet, die gern neue Leute kennenlernen.

Die Tour findet bei jedem Wetter statt, da die meisten Stationen in gemütlichen Innenräumen liegen. Hotelabholung und Rücktransport zum Hotel sind im Preis inbegriffen. Bitte kommen Sie nicht ganz hungrig, planen Sie aber auch kein großes Abendessen direkt davor ein. Die Gruppe bleibt bewusst überschaubar, damit jeder genügend Zeit zum Probieren und Fragen hat.
meeting_point: Piazza di Santa Maria in Trastevere, vor dem Brunnen in der Mitte des Platzes, 00153 Rom
inclusions: Snacks zu den Bieren (Käse, Wurst, Brot)
cancellation_policy: Kostenlose Stornierung bis 24 Stunden vor Beginn der Tour. Bei späterer Absage oder Nichterscheinen ist keine Erstattung möglich.

title: Bo-Kaap and City Bowl Photography Walk Workshop
short_description: Learn to shoot colour, light and street life on a guided photography walk through Cape Town's Bo-Kaap and City Bowl.
description: Learn to shoot colour, light and street life on a guided photography walk through Cape Town's Bo-Kaap and City Bowl. Led by a local professional photographer, this hands-on workshop turns a relaxed stroll into a practical lesson in composition. You will begin with a short briefing on camera settings, framing and reading natural light, then head out along the cobbled streets, where pastel houses, mountain backdrops and everyday scenes offer endless subjects. Along the way your guide offers friendly, personal feedback and suggests angles you might otherwise miss. The pace is unhurried, with plenty of time to experiment. The walk ends at a café, where you review your best frames together and learn simple editing tips. Bring your own camera or smartphone; all skill levels are welcome. Please wear comfortable shoes, as some streets are steep and uneven.
meeting_point: Outside the Bo-Kaap Museum, 71 Wale Street, Bo-Kaap, Cape Town
exclusions: Food and drinks at the café
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start time for a full refund. Cancellations made less than 24 hours before the start are not refunded.

title: Hunter Valley: Weingut-Tagesausflug ab Sydney im Reisebus
short_description: Entdecken Sie die bekannte Weinregion Hunter Valley bei einem Tagesausflug im Reisebus ab Sydney. Mit Weinproben, Mittagessen und Zeit zum Genießen.
description: Raus aus der Stadt und rein ins Grüne: Bei diesem ganztägigen Ausflug von rund 6 Stunden fahren Sie bequem im klimatisierten Reisebus von Sydney ins Hunter Valley, eine der ältesten Weinregionen Australiens. Auf der Fahrt erzählt Ihr Fahrer und Guide Wissenswertes über Land und Leute. Im Tal besuchen Sie drei ausgewählte Weingüter und probieren dort verschiedene Rot- und Weißweine, darunter den für die Region typischen Semillon. Mittags erwartet Sie ein Mittagessen in einem Restaurant auf einem der Weingüter. Zwischendurch bleibt Zeit für Fotos zwischen den Reben und für einen Einkauf im Hofladen. Der Eintritt in die Hunter Valley Gardens ist im Preis inbegriffen. Am späten Nachmittag treten Sie die Rückreise an und kommen am frühen Abend wieder in Sydney an. Ein Tag voller Genuss, der sich ideal für Paare, Freunde und alle eignet, die Australien auch einmal von der ländlichen Seite erleben möchten. Bitte denken Sie daran, dass Weinproben nur für Gäste ab 18 Jahren möglich sind.
meeting_point: Treffpunkt ist am Circular Quay, Alfred Street, 2000 Sydney, vor dem Fährterminal. Bitte seien Sie 15 Minuten vor Abfahrt um 7:30 Uhr vor Ort.
inclusions: Fahrt im klimatisierten Reisebus ab Sydney
Fahrer mit Kommentar auf Deutsch und Englisch
cancellation_policy: Kostenlose Stornierung bis 24 Stunden vor Beginn der Tour. Bei späterer Absage oder Nichterscheinen ist keine Erstattung möglich.

title: Charlottenburg Palace Admission with Audio Guide, Berlin
short_description: Explore the largest surviving Hohenzollern residence in Berlin with a ticket to the Old Palace and a multilingual audio guide. Wander through opulent state rooms at your own pace.
description:
Charlottenburg Palace is the grandest royal residence in Berlin, and this admission ticket lets you discover its glittering interiors in your own time. Built from 1695 as a summer retreat for Sophie Charlotte, the first Queen in Prussia, the palace grew over the following decades into a sweeping Baroque and Rococo complex set beside the River Spree.

Your ticket gives you entry to the Old Palace, where an audio guide leads you through the private apartments and ceremonial rooms of the Prussian court. Highlights include the Porcelain Cabinet, with its dazzling display of blue-and-white ceramics, and the Golden Gallery, a Rococo masterpiece commissioned by Frederick the Great. Along the way the commentary explains the architecture, the dynastic politics and the stories of the people who lived here, including the painstaking reconstruction after heavy damage in the Second World War.

The audio guide is available in several languages and lets you pause, skip ahead or linger over any room that catches your eye. Most visitors spend around two hours inside, although there is no fixed schedule, so you can set your own rhythm. Afterwards, you may wish to stroll through the palace gardens, a landscaped park of tree-lined avenues, ponds and pavilions that is free to enter.

This is a self-guided visit, ideal for architecture enthusiasts, history lovers and anyone who enjoys exploring at a relaxed pace. Please note that bags and large rucksacks must be left in the cloakroom. Special access needs: please tell us when booking (write N/A if none) so that we can pass the details on to the venue.
meeting_point: Main entrance of the Old Palace, Spandauer Damm 20-24, 14059 Berlin. Show your ticket at the admission desk.
inclusions: Admission ticket to the Old Palace
Access to the historic state rooms and private apartments
cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start time for a full refund. Cancellations made less than 24 hours in advance are not refundable.

title: Evening classical concert at Palais Bahia, Marrakech
short_description: Attend a live classical concert in a historic Marrakech palace. Tickets ab 25 €. Hear a small ensemble play a mix of European and Andalusian-influenced works.
description: Spend an evening at a historic palace in the Marrakech medina. A small ensemble plays a programme of classical music, including pieces from the Andalusian tradition. Skip-the-line entry for all ticket holders. Seating is in the main courtyard. The concert lasts about 90 minutes with a short interval. Mint tea is served during the interval. Arrive 15 minutes early to find your seat. Dress is smart casual.

title: Street Art und Stadtviertel in Marrakesch zu Fuß entdecken
short_description: Entdecken Sie auf einem Spaziergang mit einem lokalen Guide die bunten Wandbilder und lebendigen Viertel von Marrakesch abseits der bekannten Touristenpfade.
description: Marrakesch hat mehr zu bieten als Souks und Paläste. Dies ist die offizielle Street-Art-Tour von Marrakesch. Bei diesem Rundgang erkunden Sie das Viertel Gueliz und angrenzende Straßen, in denen Künstler aus Marokko und aller Welt farbenfrohe Wandbilder hinterlassen haben. Ihr Guide erzählt Ihnen von den Motiven, den Künstlern und dem Alltag der Menschen vor Ort. Unterwegs legen wir eine Pause für einen Minztee ein. Ideal für Kreative, Fotografen und alle, die die Stadt einmal anders erleben möchten.
meeting_point: Place du 16 Novembre, vor dem Haupteingang des Bahnhofs-Boulevards, Gueliz, Marrakesch
